checks: Source 293336b22f4df188 §§1–4 gives the same strip and triangle, both ambient perturbations, exact polynomial test, and strict area comparison. The replacement by disjoint radial triangles is valid even without separately proving positive turn determinants.

The linewise first variation has a signed proper contribution and a positive part on the outside supporting edge. Compactness bounds the perturbation along all lines, and the difference quotient is dominated by the magnitude of the linear increment. Proper section endpoints and outside supporting edge endpoints have one-dimensional measure zero.

Both endpoint sections have length three. Their first moments are -3 and -3/2, with opposite base-tilt contributions. Taking a large positive base tilt activates the entire outside edge for either sign of the tangential increment, forcing p_i²-q_i²=9 on both axes.

The four specified midpoint points are actual midpoint vertices. The segments to the positive chord endpoints give the crossed lower bounds for q_1 and q_2. Using the smaller positive endpoint gives the normalized inequality with increasing left side and decreasing right side.

Independent exact symbolic replay derived the four offsets, the seven positive coefficients in the shift L-5, the polygon-area expression, and equality to 6L+9/2 at the exact threshold p_H. The failed test at p_H forces p>p_H, including at L=5.

All six sector triangles are in K by convexity and lie in disjoint angular interiors, with all gaps less than π because U>V>0 and W>J>0. Their summed area is strictly above the endpoint total for the chosen p_0>p_H. The coordinate Jacobian has absolute value two.
